death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «Мученик Зосима пустынник жил в IV веке»; the day prints «(IV)».

feast.note: The Sretensky day prints «Мч. Зосимы пустынника (IV)». Its name page lists this life under Zosimas of Cilicia beside a second life, of a venerable martyr Zosimas of Cilicia, and that second life is the Romanian 4 January row below; the author ruled on 3 October 2026 that the two are one man and this record is the merge of the two folders the corpus held.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 сентября ст. ст. — «Мч. Зосимы пустынника (IV)»

feast.note: The Romanian calendar keeps him on this day and not on 2 octombrie, the civil day of the Russian and Serbian 19 September, where doxologia.ro’s list does not name him (checked 2026-09-17). Its line is no more than „Sfântul Mucenic Zosima” and its life is the one the Sretensky name page files beside the hermit’s: the monk of Cilicia among the beasts, the governor Dom(e)tian, and the lion — which is why the two are one record.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 4 ianuarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Zosima»

attestations.note: Not on saint.gr’s list for 2 Οκτωβρίου, the civil day of the Russian and Serbian 19 September (checked 2026-09-17), nor read for 4 Ιανουαρίου, the Romanian day.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.10.2026 (19. септембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Зосим пустињак“
